channel.title: 423.news — Breaking News & Scanner Wire
channel.description: Live local news, verified police/fire dispatch, traffic, and weather for East Tennessee and North Georgia.

item.title: No weather advisories across the region; dry stretch holds until rain returns Sunday
item.description: The National Weather Service office in Morristown reports no watches, warnings or advisories in effect for the region as of its Wednesday morning map update.

item.title: I-26 lane closures continue in Sullivan and Unicoi counties through Nov. 1
item.description: State road records show resurfacing work on Interstate 26 in Sullivan County between mile markers 0.2 and 5.4, with possible delays overnight from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m.

item.title: Early voting ends Thursday in Tennessee and Virginia ahead of the Nov. 3 election
item.description: Early voting for the Nov. 3 general election closes Thursday, Oct. 29, in both Tennessee and Virginia.

item.title: Two passengers stabbed inside a moving vehicle on I-26 in Sullivan County
item.description: Kingsport police and Sullivan County deputies were sent to the 2300 block of Idle Hour Road on Friday after a report that several people had been stabbed.
